_comment: Scenario-specific behavior overrides for the Enterprise (hierarchical organization) scenario. This is an OVERRIDE file only -- it supplements the generic config/ tree (categories, patterns, selection, protocol_codec, users, schema) rather than replacing it. Everything not specified here (canonical user/session schema, protocol & codec assignment, outcome determination, timestamps, packet counts, WAV references, validation, export) is still owned by the generic framework. Consumed by src/behavior_enterprise.py.

employees_per_manager._source: Gallup meta-analysis of 200,000+ manager-led teams: median team size 5-6; effective knowledge-work span of control 5-8.

selection._comment: Hierarchy-aware caller/callee selection weights, keyed by the CALLER's own level in the reporting tree. Mechanisms with no available candidates are dropped and the remainder renormalized at runtime.
selection._source: Employee weights reflect Wen et al.'s Enron 4-flow study: horizontal (teammate) and vertical (manager) communication dominate; diagonal (cross-department, non-reporting-line) flow is comparatively rare -- hence team_member 0.55 vs cross_department 0.10.

duration_model._source: de Mattos et al.: real VoIP carrier call-holding time is well-fit by a Pareto Type 2 (Lomax) distribution -- mean 143.7s, SD 490.4s across 10,210 sessions. Most calls are short, a few very long; a uniform range cannot reproduce this variance. Categories not listed here fall back to the generic engine's uniform draw over the category's own typical_duration_seconds band.

ring_duration_model._source: The IETF SIP CDR field-definition work treats ring time (INVITE to ACK) as a field distinct from call duration; Behan et al. measured real average ring time ~10.0s, exponentially distributed.
